sentences.text: The magnetic compass is the one navigation instrument that needs no electricity.
A magnetized card floats in liquid and aligns itself with the earth’s magnetic field.
The lubber line, a mark on the compass bowl, is aligned with the boat’s centerline, and your heading is the number on the card at the lubber line.

Mount the compass on or parallel to the centerline where the helmsman can see it, and keep magnetic and electrical items away from it: speakers, radios, phones, tools, even a drink holder with a magnet.
Moving any of these can change your compass error.
